_comment: Curated shipping-status overrides for files a human has actually read. Anything NOT listed here keeps its auto-assigned status (structural facts stay definite; capability code stays 'unreviewed' until reviewed). Keep this honest: only promote a file after reading it. Valid shipping_status values: production, experimental, simulated, unavailable, demo (plus the structural ones the generator assigns automatically).

app/backend/server.py.notes: Shipped FastAPI backend. Exposes generic /api/query, /api/mutate and /api/rpc table access (audit-flagged) alongside typed read endpoints. Fail-closed auth and SQL parameterization landed; full authorize() centralization is Phase 1 open.

app/frontend/src/App.tsx.notes: Root of the single shipped frontend build under app/frontend.

notebooks/_shared/config.py.notes: Defines SOCConfig/load_config. Contract drift: tests/smoke_test_e2e_pipeline.py imports PlatformConfig with get_table_path(name), which this module does not export that way (REV2-01, Phase 2).

notebooks/correlation/10_fuse_engine.py.notes: Dempster-Shafer combiner. Pure functions unit-tested (tests/test_fuse_math.py, 12 cases). Evidence-independence and calibrated-probability semantics disputed by REV2-02/03/06 (Phase 3 open).
